reviews.author: Jacqueline

reviews.title: Pretty bottle but leaking
reviews.body: The bottle is very pretty with vibrant prints. The kids love the design. The sprout is easy to open and close. However, it does leaks a bit from the sprout area when it’s not placed upright or you shake the bottle. Even when the sprout is in closed position. I’m in a dilemma, the bottle is really very pretty, but it’s not spill or leak proof.
reviews.author: Evelyn

reviews.title: This water bottle is perfect for kids!
reviews.body: This water bottle is perfect for kids! The Disney Pixar design is super cute and a big hit with my little one. The insulated stainless steel keeps drinks cold for hours, and the straw lid is easy to use without spills. It’s durable, lightweight, and great for school or on the go. Highly recommend for parents looking for a fun and functional water bottle!

reviews.title: So cute!
reviews.body: We love SM water bottles. I have been waiting for this particular blue Pixar one to get back in stock for over a year. My son loves pointing to all of the characters (he doesn’t watch TV but my husband and I love Disney).Anyways, besides the design, my son easily drinks from the straw. It’s super easy to clean and quite durable.
